intent_record.desired_outcome: Reduce critical agent guessing by connecting human intent and success expectations to evidence without creating a parallel lifecycle.
constraints: Keep Lite slices free of mandatory ceremony
success_scenarios: A relevant Work Slice can reference confirmed intent, expectations, guessing risk and evidence.
failure_scenarios: The addendum becomes mandatory for every task or lets the agent confirm intent.
non_goals: Replace PRD, SDD, readiness gates or the Work Slice.

success_conditions: One minimum contract integrates optional references, guessing risk, evidence mapping and reconcile.
One synthetic and one real pilot are validated.
Adaptive Skills provides a consultative clarification capability.
failure_conditions: A runtime, lifecycle, automatic approval or agent-owned intent is introduced.

must: Preserve human confirmation and unavailable/missing evidence.
must_not: Redefine expectations inside an execution plan.

acceptance_examples: Standard slice references small records and stops on high guessing risk.
rejection_examples: Every Lite slice must fill a large intent document.

expectations.expectation: One minimum contract integrates optional references, guessing risk, evidence mapping and reconcile.
One synthetic and one real pilot are validated.
Adaptive Skills provides a consultative clarification capability.

documentation_updates: Update after Adaptive Skills evidence and human review.
